This is the current read-only crosswalk for the supported Phase 4 evidence generation. It keeps record accounting separate from source and caller meaning. It does not change the preserved lane JSON, sizing record, or historical reconciliation.

- Source resolution: unresolved (4849 source gaps). Caller closure: incomplete (4849 caller gaps).
- Legacy sizing digest: unresolved. The separately versioned Phase 4 supplement proves integrity for its own selector only.
